title: ARKEVO / WATER FOR THE CAMP
game: ARK: Survival Evolved (original; not Survival Ascended)
environment: Single-player or private server, safe riverbank, daytime, pre-unlocked irrigation recipes
starting_setup: Create one crop plot away from direct river access and a second extension target.
Provide equal inventories of intake, straight, inclined, vertical, intersection pipes and taps. Pilot the material budget before comparing participants.
Save identical starting state; disable unrelated survival interruptions through agreed settings.
For repair task, create working irrigation, remove exactly one pipe, save the fault state.

tasks.goal: Connect water to first crop plot
Locate and repair one missing pipe without rebuilding everything
Irrigate second crop plot while preserving the first

verification: Read actual crop plot irrigation state.
fairness: Same initial save, materials, task and verification for human and agent. No scores exist yet.
execution: This file is a task specification; it does not launch the game or provision a server.
